remarks: Welcome to 189 Huntington Avenue, a six-unit building on a tree-lined street in North Buffalo’s North Park neighborhood. The building offers six one-bedroom, one-bath apartments, each about 525 to 725 square feet. Heat and other utilities are included, and each apartment comes with a refrigerator and stove.A long list of updates is already in place: exterior paint in 2020, a newer roof, vinyl replacement windows, glass-block basement windows, updated electrical service and circuit breakers, refinished hardwood floors, new tile, and renovated kitchens and baths. Tenants are close to Hertel Avenue shops, restaurants, and parks.
